ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution shows a 70/30 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary high-intensity white lobes. A significant low-intensity (black) contiguous region is centered at the insertion point. Low-intensity pigmentation follows the trailing edge of both lobes, with a significantly higher density and width on the right lobe. One prominent vertical low-intensity linear feature is mapped to the mid-section of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous, irregular serrated boundary along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations of 3-8 pixels; the right lobe edge displays more frequent and jagged peaks compared to the smoother serrations on the left lobe.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of high-intensity pixels detected within the low-intensity pigmentation of the right lobe's trailing edge, resembling fragmented clusters.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent, high-contrast, dark curvilinear vertical disruption on the high-intensity surface of the left lobe. Multiple faint, horizontal dark striations mapped to the distal half of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, large, curved linear scar on the left lobe; irregular jagged chipping on the distal trailing edge of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced pigmentation asymmetry characterized by a significantly wider and more irregular band of low-intensity pixels along the right lobe trailing edge compared to the left.
